question: In which of the following states is Neora Valley National Park situated?
solution:
The Correct Answer is__ West Bengal.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Neora Valley National Park is situated in the Kalimpong district, West Bengal.__
 
• It was established in 1986.
 
• It spreads over an area of 88 km².
 
• The park reaches up to an elevation of over 3500 meters above sea level.
 
• It is characterized by tropical subtropical, temperate and alpine vegetation.
 
• The forests consist of rhododendron, bamboo, oak, ferns, sal, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• West Bengal has six national parks -

 
 
• Buxa National Park,
 
• Gorumara National Park, 
 
• Neora Valley National Park, 
 
• Singalila National Park, 
 
• Sunderban National Park, 
 
• Jaldapara National Park.
